titulo: Why does my fridge leak water on the floor?

frases.texto: Why is your fridge leaking water all over the floor?
That puddle comes back once or twice a day, right in front of the door.
Defrost meltwater should slip down a tiny hole into a pan under the fridge.
Ice plugs that hole, so the water spills out the door instead.
First, unplug it, then pull out the bottom basket.
The hole is low on the back wall, dead center.
No hole, or ice all over the back wall? Call a technician.
A leak behind the fridge is the water hose. Shut that valve.
Stir a little baking soda into two cups of hot tap water, not boiling.
A turkey baster shoots it in until you hear it splash in the pan underneath.
Flush it once or twice a year, or the repair gets pricey.
Send this to that friend whose fridge keeps leaking on the floor.
